correctness.rationale: The full-CDS criterion follows from original adjacency and connectivity and has all boundary cases n>=3 checked. The exchange graph is the off-diagonal Cartesian square of J(n,2); an explicit complete case split constructs coordinate-length geodesics except adjacent swaps, where three steps are necessary and sufficient. Inclusion-exclusion over deleted diagonal endpoint pairs and a vk swap correction prove the exact ordered distance polynomial. Independent exhaustive direct-predicate testing and BFS for n=3..7 corroborate the proof.

value.rationale: Complete shortest-path metric and ordered distance distribution for natural minimum-CDS reconfiguration graphs quantify reconfiguration cost of all pairs, not just number of optimal solutions. The exceptional one-move adjacent swap delay and complete exchange-versus-sliding rigidity are structural and not implied by the previously known scalar count; the result holds for an infinite graph family.
